name: engram
conclusion_quantitative: engram (Act) specifies 2 of 5 categories: 10+ autonomy limits, 1 escalation rule; none for clarification rules, approval gates, validation rules. Strongest: autonomy limits.
conclusion_qualitative: engram sets up a memory system for agents with a knowledge graph, memory kept apart per session, fading of old memories and a hybrid search tool. Most of its control rules limit what the agent may do alone: it keeps each session's memory separate, never deletes facts, never writes the facts file directly and leaves some jobs to the periodic heartbeat. When a subagent domain misses its schedule, it raises an alert. It never tells the agent to ask the user for information, get approval, or check its own work.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_quantitative: 10+ autonomy limits (10 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: There are 10 or more rules (the first 10 are kept), all strict, none tied to a situation, mostly bullet points. They keep memory separated by session: the agent must never cross-reference memory between sessions, group chats cannot see `MEMORY.md` or `life/` (the knowledge graph, a structured store of facts), and every `qmd` search must name its collection with `-c`. The agent must not run `qmd embed` by hand, leaves watermarks (markers of what was already extracted) to the heartbeat (a periodic background run), never deletes facts and never writes `items.json` directly. During the heartbeat it approves low-risk proposals on its own.

statements.quote: Group chats **CANNOT see** MEMORY.md or life/
Main session only — group chats do not have access to the Knowledge Graph (`life/`).
Always use `-c` flag for session isolation
Do NOT run `qmd embed` manually (heartbeat handles it)
**Only heartbeat writes watermarks** — inline extraction does NOT (dedup handles overlap)
**PROPOSAL review** — `qmd query "PROPOSAL" -c domains` → auto-approve low-risk, alert user for high-risk

clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to ask the user for missing or unclear information, or to avoid guessing.

approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to get the user's permission or confirmation before doing something.

validation.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to check its own work, such as running tests, or says when the work counts as done.

escalation.conclusion_quantitative: 1 escalation rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list.
escalation.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, tied to a situation, in a bullet point. During the heartbeat the agent reads each domain's `status.md` and raises an alert if a domain has missed its schedule more than twice.

statements.quote: **Liveness check** — read each domain's `status.md`, alert if missed >2x schedule
